title: Thalamic Nuclei Atlases — thalamus
text: thalamus_hcp(): Seven nuclei groups per hemisphere, clustered Human Connectome Project diffusion MRI. thalamus_thomas(): Twelve nuclei per hemisphere, segmented white-matter-nulled MPRAGE THOMAS pipeline.
